Who We Help  /  Small Businesses

We help small businesses cut through the noise and put tech to work.

We specialize in the technology side of growing pains. Growth is good. What usually goes wrong is that the systems set up three years ago were configured before anyone asked how the staff actually work — and nobody has had the time to revisit them since.

We help small businesses...

Get more out of what you own

You have already paid for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and half a dozen other tools. We make them work the way your staff actually work, and we make your vendors deliver what they promised.

Bring in AI where it earns its keep

AI is not magic, but in the right places it genuinely gives people their time back. We help you find those places, and tell you plainly where it is not worth the trouble.

Get real value from your data

The insight you need is usually already sitting in your systems. We do the unglamorous work of cleaning it up first, then the analysis, dashboards, and reporting on top.

Make the right investments

Cut through the smoke and mirrors. We evaluate vendors, work out what a thing will actually return, and negotiate on your behalf when a vendor stops returning your calls.

How we work with small businesses

We provide the flexibility small businesses need. Have something else in mind? Let us know and we'll figure out an arrangement that fits.

  • Needs Assessment Often the first step in our process. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of your current technology ecosystem and deliver an actionable set of recommendations.
  • Packages Fixed scope and fixed price for a defined piece of work — a one-day AI bootcamp, a website rebuild, a system setup.
  • Project Work End-to-end execution for specific business initiatives or technical projects, ranging from a few hours of work to a multi-month engagement.
  • Ongoing Partnership Following a brief onboarding, we provide continuous technical and strategic support to ensure your technology scales seamlessly with your business.

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
